clips.title: The story
paras: In the Wetlands, Ormer's Revenge begins with a demand for Sarltooth's death. Ormer Ironbraid believes the raptor led the attack that slaughtered dwarven excavators at Whelgar Excavation Site, and asks you to bring back one of its talons as proof.

After the Explorer's League diggers were slaughtered at Whelgar Excavation Site, Ormer Ironbraid watched the raptors from his ridge. One beast stood larger than the rest. Sarltooth perched above the dig works, where Ormer saw it directing or leading the pack that drove the dwarves out. To Ormer, Sarltooth was more than a wild beast. He believed it had led the attack on King Magni Bronzebeard's subjects.

Ormer demands death for the massacre. He sends you up the high paths along the excavation walls to kill Sarltooth. Bring back one of the raptor's formidable talons, and the fallen workers will be avenged. Ormer wants the marshes to know that attacks on dwarven expeditions will not go unanswered.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were down there I happened to notice that one of those beasts stood out from the rest. He was bigger and more menacing. I bet he's the one who led the others here to cause the disruption to the dig site.

I ask of you now one final task, friend. See to it that Sarltooth is brought to justice. And considering the gravity of his crimes, justice in this case means death! Bring me one of his talons as proof of his death.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Is Sarltooth dead? Have you redeemed the memory of the fallen?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. Your efforts here will not be forgotten. Many innocent Dwarves died at this site, simply doing their jobs. The vengeance you delivered to those evil creatures should make them think twice before attacking King Magni's subjects ever again.
